balance_puzzle.capacity: JUDGE which translations and rotations preserve stability in a stacked structure.
balance_puzzle.description: Stack pieces until the system stops moving. Each drop translates and reorients a block, but the goal is not motion for its own sake: it is finding a configuration whose center of mass and support relations hold long enough to trigger the creature reward. The puzzle turns balance into a lived lesson about which transformations preserve stability and which topple it. It frames transformation as a negotiation with gravity.
interactions: grab and drop pieces into a taller stack
raise the structure past the height threshold
hold the arrangement stable until the timer completes
watch the reward creature emerge from a successful configuration
balance_puzzle.name: Balance Puzzle
balance_puzzle.qfep_connection: Transformation changes S while stability acts as the invariant. The stack only counts as coherent when many local moves preserve a global equilibrium.

chair_assembly_puzzle.capacity: ASSEMBLE furniture by combining translation, rotation, and scale on repeated cube primitives.
chair_assembly_puzzle.description: Assemble furniture by moving, rotating, and scaling cube-based parts into ghost guides. The puzzle shows that a chair is not a special primitive but a relationship between transformed rectangles. Snapping and growth feedback make the composition legible as soon as the pieces align. It turns affine transformation into constructive form.
interactions: grab and scale pieces into place
snap parts onto holographic ghost guides
switch furniture_type to compare chair, stool, table, or shelf targets
complete the assembly to trigger the growth animation
chair_assembly_puzzle.name: Chair Assembly Puzzle
chair_assembly_puzzle.qfep_connection: Transformation modifies S while the cube remains the invariant unit. Furniture appears when repeated primitives preserve coherence under translation, rotation, and scale.

configurable_portal.description: Fully configurable portal - any size, rotation, destination. Use: configurable_portal#width:2#height:3#dest_x:5#dest_y:1#dest_z:10 or configurable_portal#dest_map:Trans_RotationSpectacle
configurable_portal.name: Configurable Portal

parameters.dest_x: float - destination X in current map
parameters.dest_y: float - destination Y in current map
parameters.dest_z: float - destination Z in current map
parameters.label: string - text shown above portal
parameters.spawn: string - named spawn point in destination

configurable_portal.qfep_connection: The door as parameter: size, rotation, destination all data. Passage itself made configurable — the humblest artifact in the room and the most honest about what this world is (everything, including exits, is a setting).
